prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: new full-body work-angle and dance key-pose atlas for a layered desktop companion.
Reference: ONLY the SAME woman: salmon-pink long braided hair with teal ribbon, muted red eyes, black high-neck top, cream-pink artist apron, dark loose culottes, pink-white ankle boots. Adult woman aged about 25. Preserve her exact recognisable face, adult anatomy, hairstyle, accessories, clothes, palette and shoes.
Exactly eight drawings, arranged as FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of equal cells. No other characters. Keep each FULL BODY entirely within its cell, with at least 8% transparent padding on EVERY edge, including raised hands, toes and hair. Same anatomical scale in all cells; 6.5-head-tall adult proportions. Match the reference's fine crisp pixel-art black outlines and rounded shading.
TOP ROW left to right: (1) three-quarter toward left, actively working with a stylus and a small sketch tablet; (2) left SIDE PROFILE doing the same work, with a clearly different drawn torso/face perspective; (3) REAR THREE-QUARTER, same work with prop in front, looking over shoulder, genuinely drawn back of the clothing; (4) seated sideways on a simple low dark stool, working with a stylus and a small sketch tablet, complete visible legs and feet.
BOTTOM ROW left to right: four genuinely different balanced key poses for joyful J-pop dance: cheerful ready pose with knees bent; one palm lifted next to head with opposite arm out; turning three-quarter with braid swinging and opposite arm up; one heel lifted with both hands open, apron flowing. Dance WITHOUT the handheld work prop. Distinct arm, elbow, hip, knee and foot placements; do not make tilted copies. Hair/coat follow the motion naturally.
Transparent RGBA canvas, actual transparent pixels. No background, glow, ground shadow, coloured edge halo, checkerboard, grid, labels, writing, border or effects. Preserve exact outfit across all eight cells. Anatomical hands with five fingers. Each drawing will become independent head, torso, arm and leg layers for animation.
